name: coordinate_call
description: For outbound calls with coordination enabled, retrieve a mission after identity confirmation, then report discoveries as they arrive. The response supplies an outcome, sourced facts, information gaps and completion state. Choose useful questions naturally within its boundaries. A completed question or lack of a queued task does not mean the mission is resolved. Respect immediate hang-up over this tool. Never use on inbound calls.

operation.description: check retrieves the current mission without a new report; update records discoveries during conversation; finish records a final update when the person is done, preserving unresolved gaps for review before the separate report_call. Do not repeatedly check after a current response.

sequence.description: For updates, increment from 1 per call. Keep the same number and content for an exact retry. Use 0 for check.

text.description: Faithful account of what the confirmed recipient just said, including uncertainty, corrections, refusal, and important needs outside the structured fields. Identify any unanswered or declined gap. Do not turn an assumption into a reported fact. Empty for check.

facts_json.description: JSON object of changed reported facts only. Allowed: location_id (supplied scenario ID or null), needs_transport, party_size, wheelchair, pets, can_help, seats, wheelchair_space, pets_allowed. Unknown values null; omit unchanged fields. Use {} for check.

task_id.description: Current task ID returned by coordinator; empty before first check.

result.description: pending while gathering useful information; answered only when both the base mission and the current coordinator brief objective are addressed, with the account supporting that outcome in text. The response may retain the task for remaining gaps or an unacknowledged newer brief. unknown when the person cannot answer; declined when they refuse; identify the unresolved issue in text.

confirmation.description: none for information updates. Other values only for an explicit answer to the corresponding authorized arrangement task.

do_not_call.description: true only for explicit withdrawal of future contact, not merely asking to end this call.

human_review.description: Optional concrete unresolved issue needing the human dispatcher, such as possible real danger during a drill or a need outside supported fields. Preserve the person's words and uncertainty. Empty or omitted when no such issue exists; maximum 2000 characters. Never delay an immediate hang-up to submit this.

mission_revision.description: Revision of the latest coordinator_brief you have read and are responding to; 0 when none exists. For update/finish. Do not copy a newer revision and claim answered before actually addressing that objective.
